title: Trump, Xi and Putin hold their first three-way meeting
caption: Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin arrived together for their first-ever three-way meeting, held in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the APEC summit. They issued a joint 'peace' declaration that criticized the International Criminal Court but, AP noted, did not mention the war in Ukraine. Trump called Putin 'my friend'; reporters judged the results more symbolic than substantive.

stories.name: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way meeting in Shenzhen
facts: On Thursday, Nov. 19, Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin held their first three-way meeting, in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the APEC summit (AP, ABC News).
The leaders arrived together for the trilateral meeting (ABC News photo captions).
The meeting produced a joint 'peace' declaration; it criticized the International Criminal Court and called for strengthening international law (AP, ABC News).

AP reported the declaration also called for unspecified U.N. reforms, more oil supply and reduced nuclear risks, and did not mention the war in Ukraine; AP called the results more symbolic than substantive (AP).
Trump called Putin 'my friend' at the summit (AP, ABC News).

artwork.alt: Editorial illustration: three leaders in dark suits stride side by side toward a bright open doorway: Vladimir Putin, shorter with thinning light hair; Xi Jinping at the centre; and Donald Trump, with swept blond hair and a red tie, smiling. Behind them towers a nearly blank sheet of paper with four short ruled blocks, a symbol of their joint declaration. Long shadows trail across the floor and silhouetted photographers fire flashes. Represents the first Trump-Xi-Putin meeting in Shenzhen on Nov. 19, 2026.
